questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Exploring new cultures, teaching methods and academic perspectives- and meeting new people.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: It was amazing!

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Easy- we always had a person to reach out to.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: welcome session with information about where to find help if needed.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: Very well structured and good.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: living alone/with one person/with 5 persons/with 11 persons.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: shared kitchen.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: that the campus is 45 min away from the, so it makes good sense to stay on campus to meet new people.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: found very kind roommates, it was nice and clean, and the housing team took into consideration the wishes you had for housing if you applied in good time.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: sometimes hard because you were doing it all by yourself, but I always had a line to Anja, who could help me out.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: I can't remember the whole proces.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: direct line to Anja + student central.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: keep some days off, so you can go on trips to explore things.

questions.answer: no exams, but hand ins every week.

questions.answer: The students were more involved.
